content:
Let the directrix be \(x=-1\). For any \(M\) on the parabola,
\[
|MF|=\text{distance from }M\text{ to }x=-1.
\]
Thus
\[
|MP|+|MF|=|MP|+\text{dist}(M,\text{directrix})
\ge \text{dist}(P,\text{directrix}).
\]
Since \(P(3,1)\), the distance to \(x=-1\) is \(3-(-1)=4\).

Equality occurs when \(M\) lies on the perpendicular from \(P\) to the directrix, i.e. on \(y=1\). Intersecting with \(y^2=4x\):
\[
1=4x \Rightarrow x=\frac14.
\]
So \(M=\left(\frac14,1\right)\) is on the parabola, and the minimum is
\[
\boxed{4}.
\]
